name: allterrain-forms
description: Forms for WordPress with every premium feature free, as an OpenStation desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundles && npm run deploy
scripts.build:builder: ATF_TARGET=builder vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=builder vite build --mode production
scripts.build:analytics: ATF_TARGET=analytics vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=analytics vite build --mode production
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:form && npm run build:builder && npm run build:entries && npm run build:widget && npm run build:dock && npm run build:analytics
scripts.build:dock: ATF_TARGET=dock vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=dock vite build --mode production
scripts.build:entries: ATF_TARGET=entries vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=entries vite build --mode production
scripts.build:form: ATF_TARGET=form vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=form vite build --mode production
scripts.build:widget: ATF_TARGET=widget vite build --mode development && ATF_TARGET=widget vite build --mode production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.plugin:build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:bundles
